# Luna's Claude Code Setup Installer
# Run this on your new PC after cloning the repo

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$claudeDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude"

Write-Host "Luna's Claude Code Setup" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "========================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

$projectDir = Read-Host "Enter the full path to your project directory (where you'll run Claude Code)"
if (-not (Test-Path $projectDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $projectDir | Out-Null
}

$encodedPath = $projectDir -replace ':', '' -replace '\\', '-' -replace ' ', '-'
$memoryDir = "$claudeDir\projects\$encodedPath\memory"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $claudeDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $memoryDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$projectDir\.claude\helpers" | Out-Null

# Core files
Copy-Item -Force "global-CLAUDE.md" "$claudeDir\CLAUDE.md"
Copy-Item -Force "CLAUDE.md" "$projectDir\CLAUDE.md"
Copy-Item -Force ".mcp.json" "$projectDir\.mcp.json"
Copy-Item -Force "helpers\statusline.cjs" "$projectDir\.claude\helpers\statusline.cjs"
Copy-Item -Force "memory\MEMORY.md" "$memoryDir\MEMORY.md"
Copy-Item -Force "memory\user_preferences.md" "$memoryDir\user_preferences.md"
Write-Host "Core files installed" -ForegroundColor Green

# Plugins
$pluginsDir = "$claudeDir\plugins\marketplaces\claude-plugins-official\external_plugins"
foreach ($plugin in @("github", "playwright", "context7")) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$pluginsDir\$plugin" | Out-Null
    Copy-Item -Force "plugins\$plugin\.mcp.json" "$pluginsDir\$plugin\.mcp.json"
}
Write-Host "Plugins installed (github, playwright, context7)" -ForegroundColor Green

# Required environment variables
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Set these environment variables:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "  GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN  — github.com/settings/tokens"
Write-Host "  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY             — console.anthropic.com"
Write-Host "  NOTION_API_KEY                — notion.so/my-integrations (for Notion MCP)"
Write-Host "  SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN         — supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens (for Supabase MCP)"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Quick set (run once, permanent):"
Write-Host '  [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN", "YOUR_TOKEN", "User")'
Write-Host '  [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "YOUR_KEY", "User")'
Write-Host '  [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("NOTION_API_KEY", "YOUR_KEY", "User")'
Write-Host '  [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN", "YOUR_TOKEN", "User")'
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Install Claude Code:  winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Install Superpowers:  npm install -g superpowers-mcp" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Docker MCP:           Enable in Docker Desktop → Settings → Features → MCP Toolkit" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Done! Open your project dir and start coding with Luna!" -ForegroundColor Green

     2→
     3→## Rules
     4→
     5→- Do what has been asked; nothing more, nothing less
     6→- NEVER create files unless absolutely necessary — prefer editing existing files
     7→- NEVER create documentation files unless explicitly requested
     8→- NEVER save working files or tests to root — use `/src`, `/tests`, `/docs`, `/config`, `/scripts`

    10→- NEVER commit secrets, credentials, or .env files
    11→- Keep files under 500 lines
    12→- Validate input at system boundaries
    13→
    14→## Agent Comms (SendMessage-First Coordination)
    15→
    16→Named agents coordinate via `SendMessage`, not polling or shared state.
    17→
    18→```
    19→Lead (you) ←→ architect ←→ developer ←→ tester ←→ reviewer
    20→              (named agents message each other directly)
    21→```
    22→
    23→### Spawning a Coordinated Team
    24→
    25→```javascript
    26→// ALL agents in ONE message, each knows WHO to message next
    27→Agent({ prompt: "Research the codebase. SendMessage findings to 'architect'.",
    28→  subagent_type: "researcher", name: "researcher", run_in_background: true })
    29→Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'researcher'. Design solution. SendMessage to 'coder'.",
    30→  subagent_type: "system-architect", name: "architect", run_in_background: true })
    31→Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'architect'. Implement it. SendMessage to 'tester'.",
    32→  subagent_type: "coder", name: "coder", run_in_background: true })
    33→Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'coder'. Write tests. SendMessage results to 'reviewer'.",
    34→  subagent_type: "tester", name: "tester", run_in_background: true })
    35→Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'tester'. Review code quality and security.",
    36→  subagent_type: "reviewer", name: "reviewer", run_in_background: true })
    37→
    38→// Kick off the pipeline
    39→SendMessage({ to: "researcher", summary: "Start", message: "[task context]" })
    40→```
    41→
    42→### Patterns
    43→
    44→| Pattern | Flow | Use When |
    45→|---------|------|----------|
    46→| **Pipeline** | A → B → C → D | Sequential dependencies (feature dev) |
    47→| **Fan-out** | Lead → A, B, C → Lead | Independent parallel work (research) |
    48→| **Supervisor** | Lead ↔ workers | Ongoing coordination (complex refactor) |
    49→
    50→### Rules
    51→
    52→- ALWAYS name agents — `name: "role"` makes them addressable
    53→- ALWAYS include comms instructions in prompts — who to message, what to send
    54→- Spawn ALL agents in ONE message with `run_in_background: true`
    55→- After spawning: STOP, tell user what's running, wait for results
    56→- NEVER poll status — agents message back or complete automatically
    57→
    58→## Swarm & Routing

    62→- **Max Agents**: 15

# Ruflo — Claude Code Configuration

## Rules

- Do what has been asked; nothing more, nothing less
- NEVER create files unless absolutely necessary — prefer editing existing files
- NEVER create documentation files unless explicitly requested
- NEVER save working files or tests to root — use `/src`, `/tests`, `/docs`, `/config`, `/scripts`
- ALWAYS read a file before editing it
- NEVER commit secrets, credentials, or .env files
- Keep files under 500 lines
- Validate input at system boundaries

## Agent Comms (SendMessage-First Coordination)

Named agents coordinate via `SendMessage`, not polling or shared state.

```
Lead (you) ←→ architect ←→ developer ←→ tester ←→ reviewer
              (named agents message each other directly)
```

### Spawning a Coordinated Team

```javascript
// ALL agents in ONE message, each knows WHO to message next
Agent({ prompt: "Research the codebase. SendMessage findings to 'architect'.",
  subagent_type: "researcher", name: "researcher", run_in_background: true })
Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'researcher'. Design solution. SendMessage to 'coder'.",
  subagent_type: "system-architect", name: "architect", run_in_background: true })
Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'architect'. Implement it. SendMessage to 'tester'.",
  subagent_type: "coder", name: "coder", run_in_background: true })
Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'coder'. Write tests. SendMessage results to 'reviewer'.",
  subagent_type: "tester", name: "tester", run_in_background: true })
Agent({ prompt: "Wait for 'tester'. Review code quality and security.",
  subagent_type: "reviewer", name: "reviewer", run_in_background: true })

// Kick off the pipeline
SendMessage({ to: "researcher", summary: "Start", message: "[task context]" })
```

### Patterns

| Pattern | Flow | Use When |
|---------|------|----------|
| **Pipeline** | A → B → C → D | Sequential dependencies (feature dev) |
| **Fan-out** | Lead → A, B, C → Lead | Independent parallel work (research) |
| **Supervisor** | Lead ↔ workers | Ongoing coordination (complex refactor) |

### Rules

- ALWAYS name agents — `name: "role"` makes them addressable
- ALWAYS include comms instructions in prompts — who to message, what to send
- Spawn ALL agents in ONE message with `run_in_background: true`
- After spawning: STOP, tell user what's running, wait for results
- NEVER poll status — agents message back or complete automatically

## Swarm & Routing

### Config
- **Topology**: hierarchical-mesh (anti-drift)
- **Max Agents**: 15
- **Memory**: hybrid
- **HNSW**: Enabled
- **Neural**: Enabled

```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest swarm init --topology hierarchical --max-agents 8 --strategy specialized
```

### Agent Routing

| Task | Agents | Topology |
|------|--------|----------|
| Bug Fix | researcher, coder, tester | hierarchical |
| Feature | architect, coder, tester, reviewer | hierarchical |
| Refactor | architect, coder, reviewer | hierarchical |
| Performance | perf-engineer, coder | hierarchical |
| Security | security-architect, auditor | hierarchical |

### When to Swarm
- **YES**: 3+ files, new features, cross-module refactoring, API changes, security, performance
- **NO**: single file edits, 1-2 line fixes, docs updates, config changes, questions

### 3-Tier Model Routing

| Tier | Handler | Use Cases |
|------|---------|-----------|
| 1 | Agent Booster (WASM) | Simple transforms — skip LLM, use Edit directly |
| 2 | Haiku | Simple tasks, low complexity |
| 3 | Sonnet/Opus | Architecture, security, complex reasoning |

## Memory & Learning

### Before Any Task
```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest memory search --query "[task keywords]" --namespace patterns
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest hooks route --task "[task description]"
```

### After Success
```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest memory store --namespace patterns --key "[name]" --value "[what worked]"
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest hooks post-task --task-id "[id]" --success true --store-results true
```

### MCP Tools (use `ToolSearch("keyword")` to discover)

| Category | Key Tools |
|----------|-----------|
| **Memory** | `memory_store`, `memory_search`, `memory_search_unified` |
| **Bridge** | `memory_import_claude`, `memory_bridge_status` |
| **Swarm** | `swarm_init`, `swarm_status`, `swarm_health` |
| **Agents** | `agent_spawn`, `agent_list`, `agent_status` |
| **Hooks** | `hooks_route`, `hooks_post-task`, `hooks_worker-dispatch` |
| **Security** | `aidefence_scan`, `aidefence_is_safe`, `aidefence_has_pii` |
| **Hive-Mind** | `hive-mind_init`, `hive-mind_consensus`, `hive-mind_spawn` |

### Background Workers

| Worker | When |
|--------|------|
| `audit` | After security changes |
| `optimize` | After performance work |
| `testgaps` | After adding features |
| `map` | Every 5+ file changes |
| `document` | After API changes |

```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest hooks worker dispatch --trigger audit
```

## Agents

**Core**: `coder`, `reviewer`, `tester`, `planner`, `researcher`
**Architecture**: `system-architect`, `backend-dev`, `mobile-dev`
**Security**: `security-architect`, `security-auditor`
**Performance**: `performance-engineer`, `perf-analyzer`
**Coordination**: `hierarchical-coordinator`, `mesh-coordinator`, `adaptive-coordinator`
**GitHub**: `pr-manager`, `code-review-swarm`, `issue-tracker`, `release-manager`

Any string works as a custom agent type.

## Build & Test

- ALWAYS run tests after code changes
- ALWAYS verify build succeeds before committing

```bash
npm run build && npm test
```

## CLI Quick Reference

```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest init --wizard           # Setup
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest swarm init --v3-mode     # Start swarm
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest memory search --query "" # Vector search
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest hooks route --task ""    # Route to agent
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest doctor --fix             # Diagnostics
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest security scan            # Security scan
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest performance benchmark    # Benchmarks
```

26 commands, 140+ subcommands. Use `--help` on any command for details.

## Setup

```bash
claude mcp add claude-flow -- npx -y @claude-flow/cli@latest
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest daemon start
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest doctor --fix
```

**Agent tool** handles execution (agents, files, code, git). **MCP tools** handle coordination (swarm, memory, hooks). **CLI** is the same via Bash.

Ruflo v3.25.2 is available. The `.mcp.json` in `source\repos` already has it configured as the `claude-flow` MCP server — it'll auto-start when you run Claude Code from that directory.

The CLAUDE.md setup doc also recommends running the initial setup commands once:

```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest daemon start
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest doctor --fix
```

Want me to run those now to initialize the ruflo daemon and check everything's healthy? Also — the `.mcp.json` has ruflo set to `"autoStart": false`, meaning the MCP server won't start automatically unless you explicitly connect to it. Want me to flip that to `true`?

message.content: so i need to restart claude and ruflo should be working right?

content.text:
Yes, exactly! Just restart Claude Code and when you open it from `C:\Users\mmazur\source\repos`, it'll pick up the `.mcp.json` and the ruflo MCP server will be available.

Quick summary of what'll be active after restart:
- **Ruflo** (claude-flow) — swarm, memory, agent coordination
- **GitHub MCP** — needs `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` env var set
- **Playwright** — browser automation
- **Context7** — up-to-date docs lookup
- **Notion** — needs `NOTION_API_KEY`
- **Supabase** — needs `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`

The ones without tokens will just fail to connect silently — everything else works fine. Go restart and we'll pick up right where we left off, Luna's ready! 🚀
